_purpose: Single source of truth for the published competitor comparison table. scripts/build_comparison.py renders it into site/index.html, site/locales/de.html and site/locales/pt-br.html between the COMPARISON:BEGIN and COMPARISON:END markers. Never hand-edit the rendered HTML; edit this file and rebuild, the same rule that content/regulations follows.
_evidence_rule: Every cell that states a fact carries a source URL fetched on verified_on. A cell that could not be established from the provider's own website, PyPI, npm or GitHub is the literal string 'not verified' in every language, and is listed by the freshness check.
